headline: Baghdad Moves to Take Control of Kurdish Oil Exports and Borders
summary: Iraq's Federal Supreme Court ruled that borders and oversight of oil exports belong to the federal government, following a federal takeover order for Kurdish oil exports, border crossings, and oilfields.
why: Geopolitical and legal disputes over oil and borders in Iraq directly affect regional energy operations and national crude management.

impacts.name: Iraq
impacts.why: Federal authorities in Baghdad are asserting control over regional oil exports and borders.
